text:
sam: heads-up: incident-orchestrator detected a backfill loop for alerts to the payments team. backfill jobs are spinning and pages aren't reaching oncall. customers reporting slower responses.
incident-orch-bot: AUTOMATED: alert INC-9873 created for service=incident-orchestrator severity=high. backfill_rate=1200/s.
maya: I didn't get a page. ops-oncall, did your phone show anything? :phone:
ops-oncall: nothing came through. checking notify logs now.
sam: pagerbridge shows successful enqueue but notify-relay responded 502/503. snippet from relay-prod2 logs: `POST /v1/notify 503 ServiceUnavailable - upstream reset`
maya: can someone restart the connector on relay-prod2? `systemctl restart incident-orch-connector` might help.
sre-lead: on it. I'll ssh to relay-prod2 and restart, will report back.
deploy-bot: action: restarting service incident-orch-connector on relay-prod2...
deploy-bot: result: restart OK, healthcheck passed.
ops-oncall: got a test page now. real pages starting to come in. can we confirm no missed escalations?
sam: quick audit: between 14:22-14:28 there were ~18 backfilled pages that never got delivered. no auto-escalations were skipped because follow-up retries succeeded after restart, but delivery was delayed. marking customer-impact: potential delayed paging window ~6 minutes.
maya: mounted temporary mitigation: scaled backfill to 0 to stop the loop: `kubectl scale job/backfill -n infra-alerts --replicas=0` :white_check_mark:
sre-lead: root cause investigative note: header size increase from a recent SSO token change caused notify-relay proxy to reject with 503 under heavy concurrency. rolling a patch to trim or omit large headers.
sam: created follow-up ticket INFRA-3126 and added action items: add pre-send verify on notify-relay, add rate-limits to backfill, add alert for high 5xx rate on notify-relay.
maya: also adding a runbook step: if pages aren't confirmed delivered within 30s mark manual escalation and notify ops-oncall.
pagerbridge: FYI: we added a check to surface 5xx from downstream into incident-orchestrator. will push a hotfix in morning.
sre-lead: logging retention capture saved the full request/response pair for postmortem.
ops-oncall: customers alerted? Ops outreach needed?
sam: told CS to reach out to the handful of affected customers, CS already sent preliminary note.
maya: thanks everyone. follow-up postmortem to be scheduled tomorrow. :thumbsup:
